title: Discharge
author: Antara Mukherjee
text:
The windows of the green room,
by a magic wand of discharge,
raises its curtains to
exhale exchanges that went on a hibernation.
Back to basics, we linger on aqua vitae
Single or Blended malt, notwithstanding.
